notes.title: PAPERHEAD EP.0 RELEASE IS TODAY
notes.notes:
Hey folks! 

We're reaching out today to remind you that

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3008200/PAPERHEAD_EP0/

[h2]PAPERHEAD EP.0 LAUNCHES TODAY! NOVEMBER 14TH![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171025/b71b643d3c726353eee54950ec0d6f4e43f8bdae.gif[/img]

[h2]100% FREE, 666% COOL, 69% CELLULOSE[/h2]

And we’d like to tell you a bit about what awaits you in EP.0:
[list]
[*] 6 missions packed with a bipolar experience (i hate it's awesome): from bone-chilling body horror to a fast-paced, brutal boomer shooter
[*] 3 characters (so you can replay levels until your nose bleeds)
[*] a performance ranking system (speedrunners, saddle up!)
[*] 11 achievements (find all the memes)
[*] and a powerhouse soundtrack (METAL??? PAPER???)
[/list]
The prologue launches tomorrow during the day! We won’t reveal the exact time, but we’ll keep you posted!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171025/e7b132ef1fe39ebff487dc241ed67527c94a0ef0.gif[/img]

Also join our Discord and X for some hot stuff!

See you tomorrow!
